A '''targeting computer linkup helmet''',<ref name="GG1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref> also known as a '''targeting and tracking computer linkup helmet'''<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> and a '''computerized gunnery helmet'''<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> was a combat helmet used by [[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunners]].<ref name="DSTC" /> The helmets assigned in weapons targeting,<ref name="GG1" /> and were worn by gunners assigned to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]<ref name="DSTC" /> and gunners serving onboard [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|torpedo spheres]].<ref name="LE" />

The helmet was cast from [[neutral alloy armor]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|imperialgunner|Imperial gunner}}</ref> and offered protection for the gunner during combat operations.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> The clamshell design included a [[Polarized lens filter|polarized filter]] to protect the gunner's eyes from blinding flashes caused by weapons discharges, and the eye slit was used to display tracking data for the wearer.<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> The helmets were also equipped with [[Macrobinocular viewplate/Legends|macrobinocular viewplates]] and [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] to assist in the gunner in tracking fast-moving targets.<ref name="ISB" />

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
During production of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the nickname for the Death Star gunners' helmets was "beetle helmets."<ref name="DB" />
